hero.description: Capture ideas instantly. Your data stays absolutely private. Built on Apple native technology for deep recording and lasting privacy.

privacy.title: Your Data Should Be Yours to Control
privacy.description: OrbNote follows a "local-first + user-owned cloud" philosophy. We don't run any backend servers, which means we simply cannot see any of your notes.

privacy-e2ee.title: E2EE Deeply Integrated with Apple CloudKit
privacy-e2ee.description: Leveraging iCloud's Advanced Data Protection, your content is end-to-end encrypted during both transmission and storage. Only your own devices can decrypt the content—not even Apple or us can read it.

links.text: Learn about iCloud Advanced Data Protection

privacy-icloud.title: Uses Your iCloud Storage
privacy-icloud.description: To ensure a pristine privacy environment, OrbNote directly uses your personal iCloud storage. We don't charge "storage fees"—all media attachments use your own iCloud quota.

privacy-ownership.title: Data Ownership That's Forever Yours
privacy-ownership.description: Since your data lives in your iCloud, you maintain absolute ownership at all times. No need to worry about losing data if the app ever shuts down.

features-intro.title: From Quick Thoughts to Epic Writings
features-intro.description: A conversational interface that feels like chatting. The timeline layout makes capturing ideas effortless, with support for replies, reactions, and quotes.

showcase.title: Mac · iPhone · iPad · Watch
showcase.description: Wherever you are, whatever device you're on, capture your ideas in an instant.

macos.title: macOS
macos.description: Even without opening the main app, summon a floating window with a global shortcut, auto-listen to clipboard, and save instantly.

ios.title: iOS / iPadOS
ios.description: Deep integration with Share Sheet and Shortcuts for automated capture workflows.

watchos.title: watchOS
watchos.description: Raise your wrist and record. Voice input supported. Your idea is on your Mac the next second.

longtext.title: Who Said Chat Boxes Are Only for Short Messages?
longtext.description: OrbNote natively supports long-form text entry and management. Use it as a long-form editor with article management mode to keep deep content organized.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
body: Q: Why does OrbNote use my iCloud storage?

A: Because we don't store your data. For ultimate privacy, we hand sync control back to you. This means you don't need to pay extra subscription fees for "cloud storage"—just use your existing iCloud space.
Q: What if my iCloud storage is full?
A: OrbNote will show a sync failure notice. You can free up iCloud space or upgrade your Apple storage plan. Your local data remains safe—it just won't sync to other devices.
